svg.title: Why lasso shows no p-values
svg.desc: A lasso looks at your data and keeps only the details that help predict the outcome. Here it keeps three of eight. A p-value assumes you chose what to test before you looked at the data, but the data chose these details, so a p-value would look surer than it is and is not shown. Instead you see which details were kept and how well they predict new students.

text.tspan: Shown instead: what was kept, and how well it predicts
A lasso looks at the data and keeps the details that help.
The data chose which details to keep.
A p-value assumes you chose before looking.
So a p-value here would look surer than it is.
You see what was kept and how well it predicts.
